description: Eval set for POST /ask. Each answerable item has a reference SQL query; the runner executes it and compares its result with the result of the SQL the model wrote (result equivalence, not SQL text). Match modes: rows = same rows (any order, any column names or units), contains = every reference row appears, value = the single reference value appears, cells = every reference cell appears somewhere, top = same first-row label, overlap = at least `min` reference labels appear. Snapshots are the reference results on the data noted in data_as_of; refresh them with `python -m stakeflow_api.evals.run --snapshot`.

items.question: Who operates Johan Sverdrup?

items.question: Top 10 gas fields in 2025
items.reference_sql:
SELECT f.name AS field, SUM(p.gas_sm3) / 1e9 AS gas_bn_sm3
FROM marts.fct_field_production_monthly p
JOIN marts.dim_field f ON f.field_id = p.field_id
WHERE p.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY f.name
ORDER BY gas_bn_sm3 DESC
LIMIT 10;

items.question: How much oil did the Norwegian shelf produce in 2025, in million Sm³?
items.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(oil_sm3) / 1e6 AS oil_million_sm3 FROM marts.fct_field_production_monthly WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'

items.question: How many fields produced oil or gas in the latest month?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT field_id) AS fields FROM marts.fct_field_production_monthly WHERE month = (SELECT latest_month FROM marts.meta_data_freshness) AND oe_sm3 > 0

items.question: Which company had the highest net production in the latest month?
items.reference_sql: SELECT g.display_name AS company, p.boe_per_day / 1000 AS kboe_d FROM marts.fct_group_production_monthly AS p JOIN marts.dim_company_group AS g ON g.group_id = p.group_id WHERE p.month = (SELECT latest_month FROM marts.meta_data_freshness) ORDER BY p.boe_per_day DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Top 5 companies by average net production in 2025, in kboe/d
items.reference_sql: SELECT g.display_name AS company, SUM(p.oe_sm3) * 6.2898 / 365 / 1000 AS kboe_d FROM marts.fct_group_production_monthly AS p JOIN marts.dim_company_group AS g ON g.group_id = p.group_id WHERE p.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY g.display_name ORDER BY kboe_d DESC LIMIT 5

items.question: How many producing fields does Aker BP operate?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fields FROM marts.dim_field WHERE operator_group_id = 'aker-bp' AND status = 'Producing'

items.question: What share of Norway's offshore gas production in 2025 came from Troll, in percent?
items.reference_sql: SELECT 100 * SUM(p.gas_sm3) FILTER (WHERE f.name = 'TROLL') / SUM(p.gas_sm3) AS troll_share_pct FROM marts.fct_field_production_monthly AS p JOIN marts.dim_field AS f ON f.field_id = p.field_id WHERE p.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'

items.question: What was Johan Sverdrup's average daily production in 2025, in thousand barrels of oil equivalent per day?
items.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(p.oe_sm3) * 6.2898 / 365 / 1000 AS kboe_d FROM marts.fct_field_production_monthly AS p JOIN marts.dim_field AS f ON f.field_id = p.field_id WHERE f.name = 'JOHAN SVERDRUP' AND p.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'

items.question: Which Aker BP fields changed the most compared with a year ago?
items.note: From the Ask preview. The period is open to interpretation (latest month, two months, a year), so only the field that changed most is checked: Johan Sverdrup under any reasonable reading.
items.reference_sql:
WITH by_field AS (
    SELECT f.name AS field,
           SUM(p.oe_sm3) FILTER (WHERE p.month >= DATE '2026-07-01') * 6.2898 / 62 / 1000
               AS jul_aug_2026_kboe_d,
           SUM(p.oe_sm3) FILTER (WHERE p.month < DATE '2026-07-01') * 6.2898 / 62 / 1000
               AS jul_aug_2025_kboe_d
    FROM marts.fct_company_field_production_monthly p
    JOIN marts.dim_field f ON f.field_id = p.field_id
    WHERE p.group_id = 'aker-bp'
      AND p.month IN (DATE '2025-07-01', DATE '2025-08-01',
                      DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01')
    GROUP BY f.name
)
SELECT field, jul_aug_2026_kboe_d, jul_aug_2025_kboe_d,
       jul_aug_2026_kboe_d - jul_aug_2025_kboe_d AS change_kboe_d
FROM by_field
ORDER BY abs(jul_aug_2026_kboe_d - jul_aug_2025_kboe_d) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 6;

items.question: Which fields are declining fastest?
items.note: From the Ask preview. Thresholds and periods vary between reasonable readings, so two of the reference's five fields are enough.
items.reference_sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(month) AS m FROM marts.fct_field_production_monthly)
SELECT f.name AS field,
       (cur.boe_per_day / ago.boe_per_day - 1) * 100 AS change_pct
FROM latest
JOIN marts.fct_field_production_monthly cur ON cur.month = latest.m
JOIN marts.fct_field_production_monthly ago
  ON ago.field_id = cur.field_id
 AND ago.month = (latest.m - INTERVAL '12 months')::date
JOIN marts.dim_field f ON f.field_id = cur.field_id
WHERE ago.boe_per_day > 10000
ORDER BY change_pct
LIMIT 5;

items.question: How has Vår Energi's oil share changed?
items.note: From the Ask preview. The model may start earlier than 2021; every reference year must be there.
items.reference_sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM month) AS year,
       SUM(oil_sm3) / SUM(oe_sm3) * 100 AS oil_share_pct
FROM marts.fct_group_production_monthly
WHERE group_id = 'var-energi' AND month >= DATE '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

items.question: How did Aker BP's average net production in 2025 compare with 2024, in kboe/d?
items.reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM month) AS year, SUM(oe_sm3) * 6.2898 / (CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM month) = 2024 THEN 366 ELSE 365 END) / 1000 AS kboe_d FROM marts.fct_group_production_monthly WHERE group_id = 'aker-bp' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

items.question: Was Johan Sverdrup's average production higher in 2025 than in 2024? Give both in kboe/d.
items.reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM p.month) AS year, SUM(p.oe_sm3) * 6.2898 / (CASE WHEN EXTRACT(year FROM p.month) = 2024 THEN 366 ELSE 365 END) / 1000 AS kboe_d FROM marts.fct_field_production_monthly AS p JOIN marts.dim_field AS f ON f.field_id = p.field_id WHERE f.name = 'JOHAN SVERDRUP' AND p.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

items.question: Which month in 2025 had the highest total gas production on the Norwegian shelf?
items.reference_sql: SELECT month FROM marts.fct_field_production_monthly WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY SUM(gas_sm3) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: By how many percent did total Norwegian shelf production in the latest month differ from the same month a year earlier?
items.reference_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT latest_month AS m FROM marts.meta_data_freshness) SELECT (SUM(p.boe_per_day) FILTER (WHERE p.month = latest.m) / SUM(p.boe_per_day) FILTER (WHERE p.month = (latest.m - INTERVAL '12 months')::date) - 1) * 100 AS change_pct FROM marts.fct_field_production_monthly AS p CROSS JOIN latest

items.question: Who owns the most of Johan Castberg?
items.reference_sql:
SELECT g.display_name AS owner, SUM(o.share_pct) AS share_pct
FROM marts.fct_field_ownership o
JOIN marts.dim_field f ON f.field_id = o.field_id
JOIN marts.dim_company_group g ON g.group_id = o.group_id
WHERE f.name = 'JOHAN CASTBERG' AND o.is_current
GROUP BY g.display_name
ORDER BY share_pct DESC;

items.question: When did Lundin's stake in Johan Sverdrup end?
items.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(o.valid_to) AS stake_ended FROM marts.fct_field_ownership AS o JOIN marts.dim_company AS c ON c.company_id = o.company_id JOIN marts.dim_field AS f ON f.field_id = o.field_id WHERE f.name = 'JOHAN SVERDRUP' AND c.name ILIKE 'lundin%'

items.question: List the current owners of Johan Sverdrup with their shares.
